membership.navigation.schemes.label: Schemes
membership.navigation.lists.label: Verification lists
membership.navigation.mine.label: Membership
membership.screens.sides.members-help: Holders become members: the members' area opens for them while the membership is current.
membership.screens.sides.audience-help: For Friends and supporters: benefits such as a ticket price, never the members' area.
membership.screens.length-rules.rolling-: Each membership runs for a number of months from the day it starts.
membership.screens.length-rules.fixed: To a set day each year
membership.screens.length-rules.fixed-he: Every membership ends on the same day of the year, whenever it was taken.
membership.screens.length-rules.indefini: For honorary and life memberships. It never lapses.
membership.screens.join-modes.apply-help: Shown in My account with a button to join.
membership.screens.join-modes.staff-only: For honorary and life memberships, or members another body tells you about.
membership.screens.checklist.length-opti: Add at least one length people can hold it for.
membership.screens.checklist.members-are: Switch the members' area on, or put the scheme on the supporters' side.
membership.screens.checklist.verifier: Choose the list this scheme checks against, and save a list key on Membership > Lists.
membership.screens.checklist.application: Approval needs an application form, which is not available yet.
membership.screens.checklist.price: Switch the Membership fees module on and set a price for joining at every length on the Fees page, or turn off "Members pay a fee through this site".
membership.screens.schemes.help: The memberships the theatre offers. A scheme starts as a draft and opens once it is ready.
membership.screens.schemes.empty-help: Create a scheme for your members, or for Friends and supporters.
membership.screens.scheme.name: Name
membership.screens.scheme.name-help: Such as "Student member" or "Friend of the theatre".
membership.screens.scheme.key-help: Used in the address of the join page. Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens.
membership.screens.scheme.key-fixed: Fixed now the scheme has been opened, because people may have the address saved.
membership.screens.scheme.summary-help: One or two sentences shown where schemes are listed.
membership.screens.scheme.side-help: Whether holding it makes somebody a member.
membership.screens.scheme.side-locked: Fixed now that somebody has held this scheme. Close it and create another to change sides.
membership.screens.scheme.fixed-end-help: The day every membership ends. 29 February is not offered.
membership.screens.scheme.rollover: Days before the end that count as next year
membership.screens.scheme.rollover-help: Somebody joining this close to the end date is given the following year as well.
membership.screens.scheme.renewal-opens: Days before the end renewal opens
membership.screens.scheme.grace-help: How long a membership still counts after its end date.
membership.screens.scheme.requires-payme: Members pay a fee through this site
Switch on the Membership fees module to collect a fee through this site. Until then members pay somebody else, such as a students' union.
Needs the Membership fees module and a price, set on the Fees page. Leave it off where members pay somebody else, such as a students' union.
membership.screens.scheme.holder-may-end: Holders may end their own membership
Turn this off where another body, such as a students' union, owns the membership.
membership.screens.scheme.accepts-refere: A buyer may type a current holder's member number at the checkout to get the member price. Anybody who knows a number can type it, so these tickets are always checked again at the door.
membership.screens.scheme.confirm-closed: Nobody new can join. Current members keep their membership and can still renew.
membership.screens.scheme.confirm-archiv: It is hidden from lists. Current memberships run to their end and cannot be renewed.
membership.screens.scheme.confirm-delete: The draft and its lengths are deleted.
membership.screens.lengths.title: Lengths
membership.screens.lengths.help: What people can hold this scheme for, such as 1 year and 3 years. Counted in {unit}.
membership.screens.lengths.indefinite: A scheme that lasts until somebody ends it has no lengths.
membership.screens.lengths.ends-by-list: A membership ends when the list says it does, such as when a students' union membership ends
membership.screens.lengths.withdrawn: Withdrawn: nobody new can choose it
membership.screens.lengths.name: Name
membership.screens.lengths.empty-help: Add at least one, such as 1 year, before the scheme can open.
membership.screens.add-member.title: Add member
membership.screens.add-member.fee-link-h: They are emailed a link to their own Pay page. The membership starts when they pay.
membership.screens.add-member.fee-waive-: The membership starts now and nothing is paid. Say why in the note.
membership.screens.add-member.waive-note: Why the fee is waived. For staff; never shown to the member.
membership.screens.add-member.link-sent: Added, and a link to pay has been sent
membership.screens.add-member.help: The membership is active straight away. If nobody has an account with this address, one is made for them to claim when they first sign in.
membership.screens.add-member.reference-: Optional. Checked against {list}, and the entry is used up. Its end date applies unless you set one.
membership.screens.add-member.already-en: This end date has already passed
The membership will count as lapsed as soon as it is added, and will still use up a member number.
membership.screens.add-member.name: Name
membership.screens.add-member.name-help: Used only if a new account is made.
membership.screens.add-member.ends-help: Leave empty to follow the scheme's length.
membership.screens.add-member.opens-area: They will see the members' area the next time they open a page.
membership.screens.add-member.no-area: This is a supporters' scheme, so they will not see the members' area.
membership.screens.mine.none: You do not hold a membership. See what the theatre offers.
membership.screens.mine.ends-by-list: Your membership ends when your students' union membership ends
membership.screens.mine.nothing-to-join: There is nothing else to join at the moment.
membership.screens.scheme.checks-help: Somebody joining a checked scheme becomes a member only once the check passes.
membership.screens.lists.help: Lists a scheme checks people against, such as a students' union's list of student IDs. Nobody can read a list back out: you can only check one entry at a time.
membership.screens.lists.empty-help: Create a list, then load the file the other body sends you.
membership.screens.lists.kinds.reference: Numbers another body gives its members, such as student IDs. Each one can be used to join by one person only.
membership.screens.lists.kinds.email-hel: Matched against addresses people have verified on their account.
membership.screens.lists.no-key-help: Save a list key under Keys, below. Until then nothing can be loaded or checked.
membership.credentials.list-key.label: List key
membership.credentials.list-key.help: Any long random string, such as one from a password manager. Every list is stored as a keyed hash made with it, so nobody can read a list back out.
membership.credentials.list-key.replace-: Every list already loaded was hashed with the old key, so none of them will match anyone until each is loaded again.
membership.screens.list.name: Name
membership.screens.list.name-help: For staff only, such as "Students' union members 2026–27".
membership.screens.list.label: What the field says
membership.screens.list.label-help: The whole question shown when somebody joins or buys a member ticket. Name the membership and who issues the reference.
membership.screens.list.label-placeholde: NNT member? Enter your University of Nottingham student ID
membership.screens.list.noun: What to call it in a sentence
membership.screens.list.noun-help: A short name used in messages, such as "That student ID is not on the list".
membership.screens.list.shape-help: Used to tell somebody they have mistyped, rather than that they are not on the list.
membership.screens.list.confirm-delete: Every entry on it is deleted. A list that memberships were verified against cannot be deleted.
membership.screens.list.load-help-refere: A CSV file with up to three columns: the reference, the date it ends and the person's name. Loading again replaces the list; an entry missing from the new file stops matching.
membership.screens.list.load-help-email: A CSV file with up to three columns: the email address, the date it ends and the person's name. Loading again replaces the list; an entry missing from the new file stops matching.
membership.screens.list.file-help: The file is read and then discarded. Only a scrambled form of each value is kept.
membership.screens.list.refused.one: {count} row cannot be read and will be left out:
membership.screens.list.refused.other: {count} rows cannot be read and will be left out:
membership.screens.list.reasons.not-well: does not look like a reference
membership.screens.list.reasons.bad-date: the end date cannot be read
membership.screens.list.check-help-refer: Type a reference to see whether it is on the list, until when and in whose name.
membership.screens.list.check-help-email: Type an email address to see whether it is on the list, until when and in whose name.
membership.screens.list.add-help: Somebody the file left out. Loading a file again replaces the list, so add them to the file too.
membership.screens.list.remove-help: Somebody who should not be on the list. They stop matching at once.
membership.screens.list.ends-on-help: Leave empty for no end date.
membership.screens.list.holder-name-help: Shown to staff to compare with an ID card.
membership.screens.list.valid-until-help: For a list that is only good for one academic year. Leave empty to rely on each entry's own end date.
membership.navigation.applications.label: Applications
membership.screens.checklist.verifier-do: Add at least one email domain that passes the check.
membership.screens.scheme.domains-help: Separate several with commas. The person must have verified an address at one of them.
Every application waits in Applications until somebody passes or declines it.
An email address at a domain
Passes at once for somebody with a verified address at one of the domains you list.
Passes at once for somebody on the list, such as a students' union's list of student IDs, and ends when the list says.
membership.screens.applications.help: Applications waiting to be checked. Passing one makes the person a member at once; declining it is final, but they may apply again.
membership.screens.applications.empty-he: Applications to schemes checked by staff appear here.
Their student ID was already used by somebody else
The name on the list differs from theirs
membership.screens.applications.claimed-: Passing gives two people one student ID. Check which of them it belongs to first.
membership.screens.applications.conseque: They become a member straight away and their membership starts today.
The application is closed. They can apply again.
membership.screens.applications.note-hel: For staff. Never shown to the applicant.
membership.screens.mine.waiting-staff: Waiting to be checked by the theatre.
membership.screens.mine.waiting-entry-al: Somebody else has already joined with this ID, so the theatre needs to check it. Contact the theatre if this is your ID.
membership.screens.mine.waiting-name-dif: The name the theatre's list has for this ID is different from the name on your account, so the theatre needs to check it.
membership.screens.mine.confirm-withdraw: The application is closed. You can apply again later.
membership.navigation.members.label: Members
membership.members.column.name: Name
membership.members.empty.title: No members yet
membership.members.empty.description: Add a member, or open a scheme so people can join.
membership.membership.no-checks: Nothing was checked for this membership.
membership.membership.end-consequence: It ends today and stops counting straight away. It cannot be reopened: if this is a mistake, add them again.
membership.membership.end-note-help: For staff. Never shown to the member.
membership.membership.waive-consequence: They will not be asked to pay, and the membership starts now unless it is still being checked.
membership.membership.refund-consequence: The money goes back the way it was paid. A refund over your limit waits for somebody else to approve it. Refunding in full ends the membership, unless the theatre has turned that off.
membership.membership.dates-consequence: Use this to correct a membership, for example to match the students' union's records. The member is not told, and renewal reminders start again from the new end date.
membership.membership.dates-end-help: Leave empty if it does not end.
membership.screens.mine.not-online: Joining online is not available at the moment
membership.screens.mine.confirm-end: It ends today. No fee is returned.
membership.screens.mine.confirm-end-memb: It ends today and you will lose the members' area. No fee is returned.
membership.screens.mine.renew-help: Your new membership starts the day after this one ends, or today if it has already ended.
membership.screens.mine.renew-help-list: Your new membership starts the day after this one ends, or today if it has already ended. It ends when your students' union membership ends.
membership.screens.mine.renew-pending: Renewal sent: {scheme}. The theatre will check it.
membership.screens.mine.card-help: Show this at the door or the desk to be scanned.
membership.screens.mine.card-no-code: Show this card at the door or the desk.
membership.screens.import.title: Import members
membership.screens.import.help: Add last year's members, or members from another system, from a spreadsheet saved as CSV. Each becomes an active member of this scheme.
membership.screens.import.file-help: Columns in this order: email address, name, start date, end date. Leave a date empty and the scheme's rule decides it.
{count} of them has already ended, so will be lapsed at once.
{count} of them have already ended, so will be lapsed at once.
membership.screens.import.skip-ended: Leave out members who have already ended
membership.screens.import.skip-ended-hel: They are not added and do not use up a member number.
membership.screens.import.reasons.dates: the end date is before the start
membership.screens.import.queued-help: They appear in the members list over the next few minutes.
membership.record-tabs.account.label: Membership
membership.screens.home-card.application: {count} membership application is waiting for a check
{count} membership applications are waiting for a check
